# Class Diagram — Domain Layer

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class IDomainEvent {
        <<Interface>>
    }

    class EntityBase {
        <<AbstractEntity>>
        +List~IDomainEvent~ DomainEvents
        #AddDomainEvent(event:IDomainEvent) void
        +ClearDomainEvents() void
    }

    class ApiToken {
        <<AggregateRoot>>
        +Id : Guid
        +UserId : String
        +TokenPrefix : String
        +TokenHash : String
        +Description : String
        +Status : TokenStatus
        +CreatedAt : DateTimeOffset
        +LastUsedAt : DateTimeOffset?
        +RevokedAt : DateTimeOffset?
        +ExpiresAt : DateTimeOffset?
        +HardDeleteEligibleAt : DateTimeOffset?
        +UpdatedAt : DateTimeOffset
        +Version : long
        +Create(userId, tokenPrefix, tokenHash, description) ApiToken$
        +Revoke(revokedByUserId:String) void
        +UpdateDescription(newDescription:String) void
        +RecordUsage() void
    }

    class TokenAuditLog {
        <<Entity>>
        +Id : Guid
        +Action : AuditAction
        +TargetTokenId : Guid
        +TargetTokenPrefix : String
        +TargetUserId : String
        +ActorUserId : String
        +ActorUsername : String
        +IpAddress : String?
        +UserAgent : String?
        +BeforeState : Object?
        +AfterState : Object?
        +CreatedAt : DateTimeOffset
        +Record(action, tokenId, tokenPrefix, actorUserId, ...) TokenAuditLog$
    }

    class TokenGenerationService {
        <<DomainService>>
        +Generate() RawToken_DisplayPrefix_Hash
        +ComputeHash(rawToken:String) String
    }

    class TokenStatus {
        <<enumeration>>
        Active
        Revoked
    }

    class AuditAction {
        <<enumeration>>
        Create
        Revoke
        DescribeUpdate
        AdminListUserTokens
    }

    class ApiTokenCreatedEvent {
        <<DomainEvent>>
        +TokenId : Guid
        +UserId : String
        +TokenPrefix : String
    }

    class ApiTokenRevokedEvent {
        <<DomainEvent>>
        +TokenId : Guid
        +UserId : String
        +TokenPrefix : String
    }

    class ApiTokenDescriptionUpdatedEvent {
        <<DomainEvent>>
        +TokenId : Guid
        +UserId : String
        +TokenPrefix : String
        +OldDescription : String
        +NewDescription : String
    }

    class AuditLogAppendedEvent {
        <<DomainEvent>>
        +EventId : Guid
        +Action : AuditAction
        +ActorUserId : String
        +TargetTokenId : Guid
        +Timestamp : DateTimeOffset
    }

    %% Inheritance / interface implementation
    EntityBase <|-- ApiToken
    EntityBase <|-- TokenAuditLog
    ApiTokenCreatedEvent ..|> IDomainEvent
    ApiTokenRevokedEvent ..|> IDomainEvent
    ApiTokenDescriptionUpdatedEvent ..|> IDomainEvent
    AuditLogAppendedEvent ..|> IDomainEvent

    %% Relationships
    ApiToken "1" --> "0..*" TokenAuditLog : produces (via app-layer same-TX, HC-1 ID-only)
    ApiToken --> TokenStatus : has
    TokenAuditLog --> AuditAction : has

    %% Aggregate publishes events
    ApiToken ..> ApiTokenCreatedEvent : publishes (Create)
    ApiToken ..> ApiTokenRevokedEvent : publishes (Revoke)
    ApiToken ..> ApiTokenDescriptionUpdatedEvent : publishes (UpdateDescription)
    TokenAuditLog ..> AuditLogAppendedEvent : publishes (Record)

    TokenGenerationService ..> ApiToken : creates raw/prefix/hash
```

## Domain Layer Notes

| 元素 | 類型 | 說明 |
|------|------|------|
| ApiToken | Aggregate Root | Token 管理的核心聚合根；新增 `Version` 屬性（optimistic concurrency）與 `UpdateDescription()` 方法（GDPR Right to Rectification）|
| TokenAuditLog | Entity（append-only）| 審計日誌實體；對齊 SCHEMA.md `erp_token.token_audit_logs`（含 `target_user_id`、`actor_username`、`ip_address VARCHAR(45)`、`user_agent VARCHAR(500)`、`before_state` / `after_state` JSONB）|
| TokenGenerationService | Domain Service | CSPRNG + SHA-256 純邏輯，無基礎設施依賴 |
| TokenStatus | Enumeration | Token 狀態：Active / Revoked |
| AuditAction | Enumeration | 4 值：`create` / `revoke` / `describe_update` / `admin_list_user_tokens`（與 SCHEMA §3.2 CHECK constraint 一致）|
| ApiTokenCreatedEvent | Domain Event | EDD §6.1.3 — token 建立時觸發 |
| ApiTokenRevokedEvent | Domain Event | EDD §6.1.3 — token 撤銷時觸發 |
| **ApiTokenDescriptionUpdatedEvent** | Domain Event | EDD §6.1.3 — token 描述更新時觸發（含 Old/NewDescription）|
| **AuditLogAppendedEvent** | Domain Event | EDD §6.1.3.1 Catalog — Audit log 寫入後通知（內部觀察性指標）|

## API Token State and Methods

| 方法 | 觸發狀態變化 | 觸發 Event |
|------|-------------|-----------|
| `Create()` | `[*] → Active` | `ApiTokenCreatedEvent` |
| `Revoke(revokedByUserId)` | `Active → Revoked`（terminal）| `ApiTokenRevokedEvent` |
| `UpdateDescription(newDescription)` | `Active → Active`（self-loop，狀態不變）| `ApiTokenDescriptionUpdatedEvent` |
| `RecordUsage()` | `Active → Active`（更新 LastUsedAt）| —（不發 event，async fire-and-forget）|
